Test Case Name: Page Layout Visibility of Cycle Configuration Fields
Preconditions: User is logged in as System Administrator with access to Setup.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Setup > Custom Metadata Types.
2. Click Manage Records next to Timesheet Default Value.
3. Click Default Values (or click Edit).
4. Inspect the displayed fields.
Expected Result: Timesheet Cycle Type, Week Start Day, and Timesheet Duration Days fields are visible and directly editable on the detail and edit page layouts.
Comments / Notes: Resolved previous issue where fields were missing from the layout.

Preconditions: User has access to Custom Metadata in Setup.
Test Steps:
1. Go to Setup > Custom Metadata Types > Timesheet Default Value.

3. Set Timesheet Cycle Type = Weekly, Week Start Day = Monday, Timesheet Duration Days = 7.
4. Click Save.
Expected Result: Settings save successfully without errors. Default configuration established for standard 7-day Monday cycle.

Test Case Name: Duplicate Prevention on Daily Flow Execution
Preconditions: Timesheet already created for employee for current cycle.
Test Steps:
1. Run Timesheets Creation STF in Debug a second time on the same day.
2. Check execution path in Debug panel.
Expected Result:
1. Get_Existing_Timesheet finds the existing timesheet.
2. Decision Check_If_Timesheet_Exists takes path Timesheet Already Exists.
3. TimesheetMasterRecordCollection is empty.
4. No duplicate records created.
Comments / Notes: Prevents duplicate timesheet creation when STF runs daily.
